Calculate per-team travel miles for each game

Source: R/travel.R
calculate_travel_miles.Rd

Builds one row per team per game and estimates travel from the team's home airport to the venue. Home games are zero miles; neutral-site games require both teams to travel. Venue coordinates come from nfl_stadiums via stadium_id, falling back to the home team's airport when the venue is unknown and the game is a normal home game.

Usage

calculate_travel_miles(
  schedule,
  team_home = nfl_airports,
  venues = nfl_stadiums,
  trip_model = c("itinerary", "round_trip")
)

Arguments

schedule

A data frame with game_id, home_team, and away_team. stadium_id identifies the venue; location ("Home"/"Neutral") determines whether the designated home team travels. season, week, and gameday are carried through when present. gameday is required for the default "itinerary" model.

team_home

Team home-base lookup: a data frame with team, airport, latitude, and longitude. Defaults to nfl_airports.

venues

Venue lookup: a data frame with stadium_id, stadium, latitude, and longitude. Defaults to nfl_stadiums.

trip_model

How to count a road trip. "itinerary" (default) chains consecutive road and neutral-site games: a team that stays on the road is charged the leg from its previous venue, and the return leg is charged to the last game before it returns home. "round_trip" treats every road or neutral game as an independent out-and-back trip, which overstates mileage for multi-game road stretches.

Value

A tibble with one row per team per game: game_id, season, week, gameday, team, opponent, is_home, location, venue_stadium_id, venue, venue_source, home_airport, trip_miles, round_trip, and travel_model.

Details

trip_miles is the mileage attributed to a team-game. Under the itinerary model, the final game of a road trip includes the flight home, so summing trip_miles over a season gives the full itinerary. Consecutive road games in adjacent weeks are chained; a bye or a longer gap resets the team to its home airport, because clubs normally return home during the bye. Distances are great-circle (haversine) miles, not actual flight routing.

round_trip is a legacy flag: TRUE means the team left its home base, including a neutral-site game in which it was the designated home team. It does not mean the "round_trip" model was used; see travel_model.

Examples

games <- subset(nfl_schedules_sample, game_id %in% c("2024_01_GB_PHI", "2024_02_BUF_MIA"))
travel <- calculate_travel_miles(games)
travel[, c("game_id", "team", "venue", "trip_miles")]
#> # A tibble: 4 x 4
#>   game_id         team  venue             trip_miles
#>   <chr>           <chr> <chr>                  <dbl>
#> 1 2024_01_GB_PHI  PHI   Arena Corinthians      9516.
#> 2 2024_01_GB_PHI  GB    Arena Corinthians     10772.
#> 3 2024_02_BUF_MIA MIA   Hard Rock Stadium         0 
#> 4 2024_02_BUF_MIA BUF   Hard Rock Stadium      2353.

# Compare the itinerary with the older out-and-back assumption
calculate_travel_miles(
  subset(nfl_schedules_sample, home_team == "JAX" | away_team == "JAX"),
  trip_model = "round_trip"
)
#> # A tibble: 70 x 15
#>    game_id season  week gameday team  opponent is_home location venue_stadium_id
#>    <chr>    <int> <int> <chr>   <chr> <chr>    <lgl>   <chr>    <chr>           
#>  1 2024_0~   2024     1 2024-0~ MIA   JAX      TRUE    Home     MIA00           
#>  2 2024_0~   2024     1 2024-0~ JAX   MIA      FALSE   Home     MIA00           
#>  3 2024_0~   2024     2 2024-0~ JAX   CLE      TRUE    Home     JAX00           
#>  4 2024_0~   2024     2 2024-0~ CLE   JAX      FALSE   Home     JAX00           
#>  5 2024_0~   2024     3 2024-0~ BUF   JAX      TRUE    Home     BUF00           
#>  6 2024_0~   2024     3 2024-0~ JAX   BUF      FALSE   Home     BUF00           
#>  7 2024_0~   2024     4 2024-0~ HOU   JAX      TRUE    Home     HOU00           
#>  8 2024_0~   2024     4 2024-0~ JAX   HOU      FALSE   Home     HOU00           
#>  9 2024_0~   2024     5 2024-1~ JAX   IND      TRUE    Home     JAX00           
#> 10 2024_0~   2024     5 2024-1~ IND   JAX      FALSE   Home     JAX00           
#> # i 60 more rows
#> # i 6 more variables: venue <chr>, venue_source <chr>, home_airport <chr>,
#> #   trip_miles <dbl>, round_trip <lgl>, travel_model <chr>
